title: On homological invariants and Cohen-Macaulayness of closed neighborhood ideals
summary: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph and $NI(G)$ be the closed neighborhood ideal of $G$ in the polynomial ring $S=K[V(G)]$. In this paper, we study the Castelnuovo-Mumford regularity, projective dimension and Cohen-Macaulayness of this ideal. For any chordal graph $G$, we show that $\text{reg}(S/NI(G))=τ(G)$, where $τ(G)$ denotes the vertex cover number of $G$. This generalizes the corresponding result for trees shown in [3], as in trees $τ(G)$ is the same as the matching number of $G$.
